column1: # Source-owned production evidence for the ILIKE scalar and vectorized leaves.

column5: The scalar ASCII-folding, escape-preserving normalization, NULL/coercion boundary, and binary wildcard match are ported as ilike_match; Go function-class construction, pattern-cache lifetime, session collations, and warning/error channels remain outside the seed evaluator.

The scalar source-owned matcher is shared, but Go chunk columns, vectorized constant-pattern memorization, per-row NULL layout, and allocator/error behavior are not represented yet; keep this file explicit PARTIAL rather than claiming vector parity.
